cohort: 48 pregnant women with Psoriatic arthritis and ankylosing spondylitis and 30 healthy pregnant women
finding: Pregnant women with PsA and AS, particularly those with high IL-17A levels in the third trimester, are at an increased risk for preterm labor, oligohydramnios, and cesarean delivery compared to healthy pregnancies.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was more common in the PsA and AS group compared to the control group (aRR 1.57, 95% CI 1.41-2.68).
